an4.138:1.1: “Monks, there are these four persons to be found existing in the world.
an4.138:1.3: The one withdrawn in body but not withdrawn in mind,
an4.138:1.4: the one not withdrawn in body but withdrawn in mind,
an4.138:1.5: the one not withdrawn in body & not withdrawn in mind,
an4.138:1.6: and the one withdrawn in body & withdrawn in mind.
an4.138:2.1: “And how is a person withdrawn in body but not withdrawn in mind?
an4.138:2.2: There is the case where a certain person resorts to isolated wilderness & forest dwellings.
an4.138:2.3: There he thinks thoughts of sensuality, he thinks thoughts of ill will, he thinks thoughts of harmfulness.
an4.138:2.4: This is how a person is withdrawn in body but not withdrawn in mind.
an4.138:3.1: “And how is a person not withdrawn in body but withdrawn in mind?
an4.138:3.2: There is the case where a certain person doesn’t resort to isolated wilderness & forest dwellings.
an4.138:3.3: He thinks thoughts of renunciation, he thinks thoughts of non-ill will, he thinks thoughts of harmlessness.
an4.138:3.4: This is how a person is not withdrawn in body but withdrawn in mind.
an4.138:4.1: “And how is a person not withdrawn in body & not withdrawn in mind?
an4.138:4.2: There is the case where a certain person doesn’t resort to isolated wilderness & forest dwellings.
an4.138:4.3: He thinks thoughts of sensuality, he thinks thoughts of ill will, he thinks thoughts of harmfulness.
an4.138:4.4: This is how a person is not withdrawn in body & not withdrawn in mind.
an4.138:5.1: “And how is a person withdrawn in body & withdrawn in mind?
an4.138:5.2: There is the case where a certain person resorts to isolated wilderness & forest dwellings.
an4.138:5.3: There he thinks thoughts of renunciation, he thinks thoughts of non-ill will, he thinks thoughts of harmlessness.
an4.138:5.4: This is how a person is withdrawn in body & withdrawn in mind.
an4.138:5.5: “These, monks, are four persons to be found existing in the world.”
